hook: <speak>Corporate loan applications come with a mountain of documents. <break time="250ms"/> <prosody rate="35%">Way</prosody> too many to review, for a single case.</speak>
waiting: <speak>A loan officer can spend over an hour on the details, <break time="200ms"/> while the customer waits on the other end for any news of approval.</speak>
tamper: <speak>And when a bad actor is involved, <break time="200ms"/> the smallest edits are the hardest to catch.</speak>
portal: <speak>So that's why we built <break time="500ms"/> the G L D B Anomaly Detection Portal. <break time="300ms"/> Its agents read every document in the case, and flag what doesn't add up.</speak>
upload: <speak>Start by uploading the full package. <break time="250ms"/> Every document is classified, and its key fields extracted, <break time="150ms"/> even from scans.</speak>
detect: <speak>A lead agent plans the investigation. <break time="250ms"/> Specialists check metadata, fonts, alignment, totals, spelling, and whether the documents agree. <break time="250ms"/> So a doctored figure, or a mismatched address, gets caught.</speak>
trace: <speak>And it's not a black box. <break time="250ms"/> The agent trace shows every step: which tools ran, what they returned, and how each flag was reached. <break time="250ms"/> Every finding can be audited.</speak>
score: <speak>Every case gets a risk rating, with the evidence behind it: what was flagged, where, and why. <break time="300ms"/> The officer confirms or dismisses each finding, and adds notes. <break time="300ms"/> And the portal recommends the documents that would settle any doubt.</speak>
dashboard: <speak>From the dashboard, officers see every case at a glance, <break time="150ms"/> drill into anything flagged, <break time="150ms"/> and keep a full audit trail for compliance.</speak>
difference: <speak>What took hours of screening now takes minutes. <break time="300ms"/> The AI does the reading, your loan officers make the call, <break time="200ms"/> and customers hear back sooner.</speak>
cta: <speak>Bring your next loan case. <break time="250ms"/> Upload the package, and see what the portal catches. <break time="350ms"/> Try the G L D B Anomaly Detection Portal today.</speak>
